I've implemented round 397 (PERF-13d) and written the report to `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-397.md`. No STOP was needed.

**What changed:** only the 5 granted files.
- `app/data/studio-lab-demo.ts`: each of the five worker-built demo sounds now waits for its own timer task before its buffer is built, so the five builds no longer share one long task. A load cancelled while it waits now fails and builds nothing. Both channels are filled from the same array instead of a 3 MB copy.
- `app/lib/arrangement/demo-synth.ts`: the old stereo-copy helper is deleted.
- New test file with rows SB1–SB6.
- New doc 253 (Georgian). Doc 247's status line and its TODO item 4 are updated.

The two source files and the test file are identical to B's sketch. The two generated sound effects (Soft impact, Slow rise) build as before, with no wait.

**Checks I ran:**
- Claims at start: identical to B's planning output.
- Claims at end: the changed claims are exactly the set §7 allows. K11 and K23 are unchanged.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and Biome on the 3 code paths: all pass.
- The 16 covering test files (219 tests): all pass. The slowest tests use under 50 % of their time limits.
- B's 7 mutants on a scratch copy: all 7 turn the tests red, same rows as B's run.
- Frozen file list: 0 failures. Protected files: 11/11 unchanged.
- Docs: 3 docs still say "In Progress (stage", and 0 say "pending".

**Not run:** the full test suite, `verify`, the build, the perf spec and any browser check. The task leaves those to C and the root gate.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer ran twice and found nothing Critical or High in the code.
- It raised one Medium: doc l.4 says "Completed (C round 397 PASS)" before C has run. I kept it, because L28 and the task require that exact text. This is flagged at the top of the report so B or C can rule differently.
- I fixed three Lows in doc 253's wording. The rest are B's sketch or already ruled by B.
- The reviewer had no Architecture note.

**One deviation:** my first edit to doc 247's TODO changed the item's opening text, which moved claim K23. I rewrote it to keep the original opening, and K23 is back to its planned value.

**Known gaps:** none of C's browser rows have run yet. In a hidden tab the timer wait can delay readiness by about 1 s, which B already accepted.

C's next checks are listed in the report. Nothing was committed or pushed.
